evidence_source: data/lounge/2026-08.json (ABSENT from Accor official lounge list)
notes: IMPORTANT NEGATIVE RESULT, and an unusually confident one. This hotel SELLS Executive Rooms but has NO executive lounge — the hotel's own Executive Room page lists breakfast (on the balcony or at The Square), late checkout to 14:00, laundry, turndown and in-room amenities, and makes no mention of a lounge, evening cocktails or club facilities. This is the clearest case in the dataset of a club room category NOT implying a lounge, which is the proxy the schema warns about. Both happy hours are paid public promotions, not status perks, and their advertised times conflict across the hotel's own pages (15:00-20:00 buy-1-get-1 vs 17:00-20:00 50% off) — verify on arrival.

hours.everglow_rooftop: 21st-floor infinity pool bar, cocktails and light bites (PAID)

alcohol_detail: Mocktail Hour is explicitly non-alcoholic. The 21st-floor Everglow rooftop bar serves alcohol but is a paid outlet.
evidence_source: data/lounge/2026-08.json (ABSENT from Accor official lounge list)
notes: SECOND COVERAGE GAP CAUGHT THIS WAY: absent from BOTH Accor benefit lists, so the extension could not see it at all. Found only by enumerating Accor's Nha Trang destination page, which lists 5 properties against the 4 our datasets knew about — the same failure mode as Movenpick Waverly in Phu Quoc. Worth treating as a systematic gap rather than two coincidences. The perk is a complimentary Mocktail Hour 16:00-17:00 plus kids' ice cream, described as an in-stay perk for guests. Genuinely free but non-alcoholic and modest. Everglow rooftop infinity pool bar on the 21st floor is a paid outlet. No club room tier and no lounge.
